QuestInfo.name: Too Shy to Say It Himself
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p402# of #m10003000# has yet another favor to ask.
QuestInfo.1: #p402# of #m10003000# asked me to deliver his gift to #b#p406##k for him. Apparently, he's too embarrassed to hand it over himself. \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 27 or higher can complete this quest.#k

0.0: I finally finished one of the gifts! Turns out wrapping it up nicely is harder than finding the thing to give in the first place, haha. But now that it comes down to actually handing it over, it feels kind of embarrassing, you know?
0.1: Whew... Actually, would you mind delivering this gift for me instead? Huh? I'm asking you as a favor here.

yes.0: Hah! Knew you were a good one. Here, just give #b#t4031127##k to #b#p406##k. Surprised that #p406#, who's always so calculating about everything, ended up helping me out? Honestly, I've always been curious about that myself. If you get the chance while you're delivering it, I'd love it if you asked about that too.

no.0: Tch, so it's "do your own errands yourself," is it?

1.0: Oh, it's #h0#? What brings you here today? Hm? #p402# asked you to deliver a gift he prepared for me? Well, this is unexpected...

item.0: Oh, hi #h0#! You have something for me? Well where is it?

npc.0: I was hoping you'd deliver that gift to #b#p406##k. What? You want me to deliver it myself? If that were an option, I wouldn't have asked you in the first place...

lost.0: Don't tell me you lost the gift I worked so hard to get. Good thing I picked it back up...
